subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this vLLM Usage-page report wait for concrete stream/transcript/API/pricing evidence, be narrowed into the unknown-pricing issue, or sponsor a new default behavior for vLLM usage/cost display?
rationale: The source path now has multiple plausible boundaries, and choosing a fix without live artifacts risks changing provider/pricing behavior for the wrong failure mode.

options.title: Wait For Evidence
options.body: Keep this issue open with a clear evidence request before queueing a fix or closing it as covered by existing code.

options.title: Fold Cost-Only Evidence Into Pricing
options.body: If fresh evidence shows tokens are present and only cost is missing, track the remaining product decision under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

options.title: Sponsor A Default Change
options.body: If maintainers want vLLM to show cost without explicit local pricing, define that product contract before implementation.

recommendation.title: Wait For Evidence
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with a clear evidence request before queueing a fix or closing it as covered by existing code.

likelyOwner.reason: The usage-cost and OpenAI-compatible transport history points most strongly to steipete for deciding the cost/usage contract boundary.
